text:
maria: heads-up — overnight canary on mi250s hit a bunch of missing HIP kernels for 2x1-quantized attention when seq_len > 2048, runtime fell back to the generic slow path and P50 spiked.

sanjay: ugh. which kernels exactly? is it a ROCm driver mismatch or registry gap? @maria can you paste the registry output?

leo: saw noise in the metrics too, KV cache hit rate dipped during the spike window. could be sequence-dependent path selection causing cache invalidation.

jess: tagging perf here. do we have a repro config? same model/batch sizes?

maria: repro config: model=redwood-v1-7b-q2, batch=4, seq_probe=[256,1024,4096]. only seq>2048 trips. quick log excerpt below: 

```
[2026-03-16T23:12:01Z] kernel-resolver: missing kernel: attn_qk_2x1_int8_mi250_seq4096
[2026-03-16T23:12:01Z] runtime: falling back to fallback_attention_generic (slow)
[2026-03-16T23:12:01Z] perf: p50_tokens_ms +12.4ms, kv_hit_rate 58%
```

sanjay: that name looks like our per-op per-arch build. maybe the upstream HIP package dropped that symbol. run `rocm-kernel-registry list --filter=attn --arch=mi250` and paste.

maria: pasted output to /mnt/logs/1951234567/kernel-registry.txt — short snippet: `attn_qk_2x1_int8_mi250_seq256` present, `..._seq4096` missing. registry has per-seqlen artifacts for some builds only.

jess: can we short-circuit with a routing predicate: if arch==mi250 && seq_len>2048 -> route to cpu-optimized kernel-pack or the smaller-attn variant? temp patch, not ideal but buys time. :thinking_face: 

leo: agree. also want to run the profiler to confirm KV eviction pattern. please capture a flamegraph for the failing sequence window (capture: rt-prof --pid XXXX --duration 30s).

maria: started a profiler now. preliminary numbers: P50 generation latency (seq4096, batch4) = 98ms (was 85ms), KV cache hit-rate 58% (baseline ~92%), batch packing reduced due to different codepath.

deploy-bot: perf-check failed on build 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z — regression detected: latency +14% on mi250 seq4096 test-suite. See artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/1951234567

sanjay: plan: 1) add conditional route in routing-config to prefer `attn_variant_smallKV` for seq>2048 on mi250 (temporary) 2) ask infra to re-run autotuner across seq-dimensions for mi250 and regen kernel registry 3) open upstream bug with ROCm about missing seq-specific kernels.

jess: I can do (1) and run a canary (10% traffic) tonight. I'll drop a rollback in case KV hit doesn't recover.

leo: I'll take (2) — schedule autotune with expanded seq grid [128,256,512,1024,2048,4096,8192] and capture kernel build diffs.

maria: filed the bug: https://issues.internal/RED-ker-1951 — attaching logs and registry diff. thanks all :heart:

jess: tagging @sanjay for the canary deploy window. i'll post canary results in this thread.

sanjay: thanks — if canary looks good we'll promote and follow up with ROCm folks.

maria: copying relevant logs to /mnt/sre/hip-gaps/1951234567/ and leaving a short runbook in that folder for rollback steps.

jess: noted. will update here once canary finishes (ETA ~45m).

leo: one ask — when you run autotune, please include build flags `-fno-strict-aliasing` and `-O3 -march=znver4` to match our mi250 toolchain, there's a subtle ABI thing we've seen.

maria: added to the autotune ticket. thanks everyone.

jess: canary report: p50 down from +12ms to +2ms, kv_hit restored to ~90% for canary slice. promoting at +2h. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: promoted. postmortem/notes later, but hotfix routing + autotune looks to have mitigated.

maria: closing this thread for now — we'll include root cause when ROCm responds. good job team :tada:
